concepts.label: universal Mersenne-subseries irrationality
concepts.note: The assertion that every infinite reciprocal-Mersenne subseries at base two is irrational.

concepts.label: terminal scaled-vanishing sequence
concepts.note: An open sequence of finite half words whose depths diverge and whose absolute terminal carries vanish after binary scaling.

concepts.label: rational half counterexample
concepts.note: An infinite support whose base-two reciprocal-Mersenne subseries is exactly one half.

concepts.label: problem-centric counterexample interface
concepts.note: The new ErdosProblems namespace wrapper around the existing terminal-scaled-vanishing consumer.

concepts.label: one-over-twenty-one rational target
concepts.note: The positive rational target 1/21, whose reduced denominator has odd doubling order six.

concepts.label: primitive 2p+3q rank cone
concepts.note: Positive coprime pairs (p,q) indexed by their rank 2p+3q in the proposed 1/21 expansion route.

concepts.label: Booleanisation gap
concepts.note: The still-open requirement that an integer-multiplicity expansion be converted into a zero-one reciprocal-Mersenne support.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: UniversalMersenneSubseriesIrrationality means that for every infinite set A of natural numbers, erdosSupportSeries 2 A is irrational.
open_antecedents: UniversalMersenneSubseriesIrrationality, the unresolved universal assertion of Erdős #257
statement_nodes.engine: problem-namespace restatement of the universal base-two subseries assertion
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The declaration restates the original problem in the expansion namespace and makes no novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is a definition, not a proof or disproof of the universal assertion.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Every HalfTerminalOnlyScaledVanishingSequence supplies an infinite set A with erdosSupportSeries 2 A exactly equal to one half.
statement_nodes.engine: direct reuse of the terminal-scaled-vanishing compactness consumer
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The theorem is a namespace-level wrapper around exists_infinite_support_half_of_terminalScaledVanishing.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: No scaled-vanishing sequence is constructed. Finite cutoff checks do not discharge the antecedent or supply an infinite counterexample.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Every HalfTerminalOnlyScaledVanishingSequence negates UniversalMersenneSubseriesIrrationality by supplying an infinite support whose series is the rational number one half.
statement_nodes.engine: rationality of one half applied to the exact infinite-support witness
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is the immediate problem-centric consequence of the existing half-support consumer.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem is conditional and does not disprove Erdős #257 without the unproved producer sequence. It adds no stronger producer than the Z12 terminal-scaled-vanishing route.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every finite set F of ranks all at least two, finiteErdosSum F 2 is not equal to 1/21.
statement_nodes.engine: reduced-denominator odd-doubling order forces lcm six, followed by exact exhaustion of the eight subsets of ranks two, three, and six
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This elementary exact obstruction is recorded as formalised route evidence; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem proves only that a 1/21 representation cannot terminate. It neither constructs an infinite representation nor proves that 1/21 belongs to the Mersenne achievement set, so it does not refute Erdős #257.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: IsPrimitive23Solution n p q means that p and q are positive and coprime and satisfy 2p+3q=n.
statement_nodes.engine: definition of the primitive rank cone used by the proposed 1/21 expansion route
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a local definition of an elementary Diophantine representation and carries no novelty claim.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The definition records rank multiplicity only. It does not identify a reciprocal-Mersenne coefficient or prove an expansion identity.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Every natural number n at least eleven has a positive coprime representation n=2p+3q.
statement_nodes.engine: explicit parity split with q equal to one, two, or four
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The theorem is elementary arithmetic formalised for this route; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Eventual rank coverage is not Booleanisation. It supplies primitive witnesses but does not show that the resulting multiplicities are all zero or one.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: The primitive 2p+3q cone has no witness at rank ten, already has two distinct witnesses at rank eleven, and has at least two distinct witnesses at every rank 10k with k at least two.
statement_nodes.engine: exact rank-ten exclusion and explicit coprime witness families for rank eleven and all later multiples of ten
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: These elementary multiplicity facts are formalised as diagnostics for the route; no novelty or priority claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The recurring collisions diagnose why the primitive expansion is not already Boolean. They do not provide the cancellations or carry recurrence required to construct a zero-one support.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The exact rational half support is the counterexample object needed to negate the universal assertion, but it remains conditional on the open producer.
The proof obtains the infinite exact-half support from the preceding theorem and applies the rationality of one half.
The conclusion is exactly the negation of the universal predicate represented by the definition.
The theorem removes the finite-support loophole for one rational target but leaves both achievement-set membership and the universal assertion open.
The coverage theorem constructs explicit witnesses satisfying the primitive-rank definition.
The defect and collision theorems are exact instance and infinite-family results for the same primitive-rank definition.
The finite-support obstruction shows what a successful 1/21 route must achieve, while the recurring primitive collisions identify the unresolved Booleanisation obstacle.
